info.label: Software Engineer
info.brief: Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience in web application development, specializing in frontend and backend technologies. Self-taught and committed to continuous learning, with a focus on building intuitive, efficient, and user-friendly interfaces.

history.summary: Client project: SIDEARM Sports — Frontend Developer working on web platforms for collegiate sports organizations, focused on building scalable, responsive, accessible, and maintainable frontend experiences.
highlights: Develop and maintain frontend applications using Vue.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and SCSS.
Contribute to the migration of websites from Vue.js to Nuxt, modernizing the frontend architecture and improving maintainability and development workflows.
Build and maintain reusable components and shared frontend packages used across multiple websites.
Implement responsive and accessible interfaces following ADA requirements and web accessibility best practices.
Improve frontend quality through SEO, semantic HTML, performance optimization, and consistent user experiences across desktop and mobile.
Translated Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UI components.
Contributed reusable components to the internal component library.
Integrated and configured Storybook to document and visually test UI components.
Improved developer experience and consistency by enhancing component documentation and usage guidelines.
Collaborated with the product team to understand requirements and business specifications around portfolio management, analytics, and risk.
Maintained a Chrome extension for Gmail and Outlook using TypeScript and Webpack.
Engineered and improved a performance-focused Chrome extension for Gmail.
Created and improved web application modules to increase efficiency and user satisfaction.
Integrated new features using Vue.js on the frontend and Laravel on the backend.
Reduced Vue.js frontend compile time by 60% through Webpack optimization.
Designed and improved email templates for reliable display across multiple email clients.

projects.title: POP Graphics
projects.description: Web application for managing company production orders and materials to improve process efficiency and operational control.
highlights: Led the development of a web application to streamline production order and material control.
Containerized the application with Docker and prepared its deployment on DigitalOcean.
